title: BEHIND THE BALLET - with Elizabeth Kaye | NEOCLASSICAL WORKS 🩰
description:
BEHIND THE BALLET WITH ELIZABETH KAYE, ABT's Dance Historian

The second installment of our 2026 Fall Season BEHIND THE BALLET is up with three pieces in our program NEOCLASSICAL WORKS; BIRTHDAY OFFERING by Frederick Ashton, Kyle Abraham's MERCURIAL SON, and BALLET IMPERIAL by George Balanchine.

BEHIND THE BALLET WITH ELIZABETH KAYE, a series of talks with ABT's Dance Historian, renowned ballet lecturer, and New York Times #1 best-selling author. Each BEHIND THE BALLET provides a deep dive into the 2026 Fall Season programs: FRESH VISIONS AND TIMELESS CLASSICS, NEOCLASSICAL WORKS, and AN ELEGY AND A DREAM.

🎟️ Purchase tickets to ABT's 2026 Fall Season from October 21–31 at abt.org
